# Nevatal

> Nevatal is an independent AI studio building focused AI workspaces, grounded retrieval tools, learning platforms, developer utilities, and engineering projects.

Nevatal designs and builds production AI applications, grounded RAG research systems, developer tools, and practical learning resources with zero required user subscriptions and full Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) privacy.

## Core Products & Platforms

- [Nevatal Studio](https://nevatal.id): Independent AI studio showcase, engineering architecture, and technical writing.
- [Projects](https://nevatal.id/projects): Directory of featured AI systems, RAG platforms, and open-source utilities.
- [About Nevatal](https://nevatal.id/about): Studio mission, design philosophy, and technical stack overview.
- [Writing & Engineering Blog](https://nevatal.id/blog): In-depth articles covering LLMs, vector search, retrieval evaluation, and AI engineering.
- [Nevatal Chat Workspace](https://chat.nevatal.id): Free open-source AI workspace with 17 specialized tools for writing, translation, document Q&A, and data analysis.
- [AI Courses & Education](https://chat.nevatal.id/courses): Free practical AI courses covering prompt engineering, document workflows, and batch processing.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/thirza258/nevatal): Open-source repository, full codebase, and deployment guides.

## Machine-Readable Agent Endpoints

- [API Catalog](https://nevatal.id/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 API discovery document listing public endpoints.
- [Authentication Guide](https://nevatal.id/auth.md): Agent authentication, key management, and security documentation.
- [A2A Agent Card](https://nevatal.id/.well-known/agent-card.json): Agent-to-Agent discovery manifest and capability metadata.
- [MCP Server Card](https://nevatal.id/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Model Context Protocol server configuration card.
- [Agent Skills Index](https://nevatal.id/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Discovery index for agent skills and function schemas.
- [OAuth Protected Resource](https://nevatal.id/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource): RFC 9728 OAuth 2.0 protected resource metadata.
- [OAuth Authorization Server](https://nevatal.id/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server): RFC 8414 Authorization server discovery metadata.
- [Web Bot Directory](https://nevatal.id/.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory): HTTP message signatures directory for bot validation.
- [Poppy Manifest](https://nevatal.id/.well-known/poppy.json): Discovery metadata for autonomous web agents.
- [AI Catalog](https://nevatal.id/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Machine-readable catalog of AI tools and capabilities.
- [Sitemap](https://nevatal.id/sitemap.xml): Public XML sitemap for search engines and crawlers.

- [Full Documentation](https://nevatal.id/llms-full.txt): Complete comprehensive documentation including full architecture, API guides, and tool specifications.
